_doc: Exact-render quality gate; design, measurements and the reason for every threshold in docs/plans/quality-gate.md. Change a threshold only together with the measurement that justifies it.
_reviewed_known_flags: How many files the committed full-corpus baseline may record as flagged by an enforced rule. Each one is a reviewed, documented fidelity difference (docs/plans/quality-gate.md, Known flags); check fails when a baseline holds more.

ink_ratio.description: inked-pixel coverage, ours / Poppler's, outside [low, high] on a page where both have ink — content drawn at the wrong scale, missing or duplicated

ink_ratio_band.description: the same ratio outside the narrower [low, high] — report only (stroke-width and anti-aliasing differences on sparse pages reach 0.5 and 2.0)

content_ssim.description: SSIM over ink-bearing windows below max with a best-shift difference above min — report only (glyph rasteriser differences put 10 % of exact pages below 0.41)

content_ssim_shift.description: content SSIM after the best ±3 px shift below max on a page where both sides have ink — report only (2026-10-31: catches the NoRotate and FontMatrix misrenders, 0.26 / 0.11 / 0.15; one legitimate exact page below 0.3 — the known hairline grid)

displaced_ink.description: after the best shift, a 32-px tile where more than min_tile_share of our ink has no reference mark within 2 px, and at least min_px such pixels on the page — content drawn where the reference has none (misplaced, turned, extra). Report only (2026-10-31: all three historic misrenders and a predefined-charset .notdef bug; 1 legitimate exact page — Poppler drops a glyph Quartz draws)

colour_tile.description: CIEDE2000 over pixels both renders draw in a flat colour (after the best shift, 3x3 neighbourhood tolerance): a 32-px tile with mean ΔE00 above max_tile_mean. Report only (2026-11-01: 88/90 hue rotations, 75/90 channel swaps, 37/90 dropped-K and 84/90 desaturations of a 48-px patch; on 154 exact page-1 renders 2 hits — DeviceCMYK conversion and a Poppler pattern-phase difference). Also evaluated on renders whose only approximations are font substitutions.

colour_hue.description: a 32-px tile where most compared pixels differ by ΔE00 > 10 at |ΔL*| < 5 — a hue or chroma change at equal lightness. Report only (detects fewer injections than colour_tile but is blind to lightness; 1 exact hit: DeviceCMYK conversion).
